Welcome to Day 5 of our 5-day yoga series focused on back health and posture. Today's session aims to improve your back's mobility and flexibility, with effective exercises for back pain relief. This beginner yoga routine is designed to ease lower back pain and support your daily stretching, fostering overall back health and flexibility. Remember to move slowly and breathe deeply.
This structured yoga series is designed to promote back health, correct posture, and improve the quality of daily movement.
In today’s session, we focus on:
• releasing tension in the lower and upper back
